purpose: Non-admission discovery record for DWD monthly lightning climatology as a hail hazard covariate.

entries.name: DWD CDC monthly lightning climatology v1.0
entries.spatial_scope: Central Europe in product title; Germany in metadata coverage field; actual grid bounds unverified
entries.temporal_scope: January 2007 onward; monthly additions per DWD documentation
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Monthly NetCDF grids at 0.05 x 0.05 degrees, EPSG:4326; flash counts and mean current in kA
entries.note: Official product description dated 2025-10-02 explicitly states CC BY 4.0 for the gridded product; do not extend this to raw LINET data. DWD describes a spatial association between mean current and hail probability, not event-level hail size or causation. Method reference: https://doi.org/10.20944/preprints202502.1749.v2 (preprint). Monthly counts cannot reconstruct storm tracks or lightning jumps. Confirm actual coverage, fill values, count definition, current sign/aggregation, missing observation intervals, grid-cell area and network changes before analysis; never interpret missing coverage as zero hazard. Exact historical file bytes and directory access not verified in this run; no data sample, database write or admission. A future test should compare matched monthly count/current rasters against independent radar hail climatology using held-out regions and years, including a count-only baseline and an ERA5 baseline.
